title: Rate Limit Awareness
definition: The awareness and management of rate limits within a decentralized network for smooth and efficient data distribution.

difficulty_levels.beginner: A system that monitors how much data can be shared at one time, and adjusts sharing accordingly to avoid any disruptions.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A mechanism that monitors the flow of data within a decentralized network and adjusts data distribution to avoid hitting rate limits.
difficulty_levels.expert: A strategy for managing data flow within a decentralized network that accounts for rate limits, ensuring smooth and efficient data distribution while maintaining the network's performance and stability.

extra_fields.insight: Awareness and management of rate limits are essential for maintaining the performance and stability of a decentralized data network.
